title: Rubio aims to convince China to ‘play a more active role’ in pressuring Iran to open the Strait of Hormuz
description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio explained Tuesday that he hopes to convince China to "play a more active role" in persuading Iran to open up the Strait of Hormuz.

title: What I’ve learned after covering 30 years of US-China ties
description: When I began covering US-China relations as a young journalist in the late 1990s, the sticking points between the two countries, especially when it came to high-level meetings, were often summarized as the three Ts: Tiananmen, Tibet and Taiwan.

title: Trump arrives in China for high-stakes talks on trade, Taiwan and Iran war
description: President Trump is in Beijing for a state visit to America’s chief global competitor, and increasingly, its chief geopolitical rival. Trump has long targeted China as an economic foe of the U.S. while cultivating a relationship with President Xi Jinping, the most powerful Chinese leader since Mao Zedong. Nick Schifrin reports from Beijing.

title: Inside China's Trump Visit Coverage: Warm Welcome, Red Lines and Taiwan Tensions
description: Chinese state media has indicated both potential cooperation and clear boundaries in US-China relations during President Donald Trump's visit to Beijing., Asia, Times Now

title: Trump, Xi set for Beijing talks with trade truce, Iran war at stake
description: BEIJING, May 14 - U.S. President Donald Trump heads into a series of meetings with China's Xi Jinping in Beijing on Thursday, aiming to secure economic wins, maintain a fragile trade truce and navigate thorny issues such as the Iran war and arms sales to Taiwan. title: China's Xi hails trade progress in Trump summit, sends Taiwan warning
description: China's Xi Jinping told President Donald Trump that trade talks were making progress at the start of a two-day summit on Thursday but warned that disagreement over Taiwan could send relations down a dangerous ​path.

title: The Latest: Trump in China for Xi meeting to focus on Iran war, trade and US arms sales to Taiwan
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has arrived in Beijing for his highly anticipated summit with Chinese leader Xi Jinping at a restless moment for a world worried about war, trade and artificial intelligence. The visit occurs at a delicate moment for Trump’s presidency, as his popularity at home has been weighed down by the U.S. and Israel’s war with Iran and rising inflation as a consequence of that conflict. The president is seeking a win by signing deals with China to buy more American food and aircraft, saying he’ll be talking with Xi about trade “more than anything else.”
